items.job: Replace electric power steering control module or rack
items.note: Owners report about $1,500 for a control module and more when the whole rack and motor are replaced. A used module is the low end.

items.job: Replace piston rings (engine teardown)
items.note: Ask an Acura dealer about extended coverage first. A used engine is sometimes cheaper than a ring job.

items.t: Passenger air bag inflator can rupture (recall)
items.job: Replace passenger air bag inflator (recall)
items.note: Free at any Acura dealer. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Replacement passenger air bag may be installed wrong (recall)
items.job: Inspect and correct passenger air bag installation (recall)
items.note: Free at any Acura dealer. Check the VIN first.

items.job: Rebuild or replace automatic transmission
items.note: Owners report about $2,400-$5,000. A used transmission costs less.

items.t: Power steering hose can leak onto the exhaust (recall)
items.job: Replace power steering hose (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 10V-174. Out of recall, owners report paying for a new hose, so ask for a written quote.

items.job: Replace power steering rack and align wheels
items.note: Owners report about $1,100-$2,000 including alignment.

items.t: Power steering pump whine or groan when cold
items.job: Replace pump inlet O-ring and flush fluid, or replace pump
items.note: The O-ring and flush is the low end; a new pump is the high end.

items.t: Rattle for a few seconds after a cold start
items.job: Replace VTC actuator (cam gear)
items.note: Many shops do a valve adjustment and new valve cover gasket at the same time.

items.t: Timing chain stretch and tensioner wear
items.job: Replace timing chain, guides and tensioner
items.note: Owners report about $1,200-$2,000. Adding the VTC actuator and water pump while apart saves labor later.

items.t: Engine can stall from a corroded engine computer (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace engine control unit (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 13V-093. Check the VIN first.

items.job: Replace A/C compressor, dryer and recharge
items.note: Owners report about $1,000-$1,900, more if the condenser must also be replaced. A clutch-only repair costs less.

items.job: Replace rear brake pads and rotors
items.note: Pads alone cost less if caught before the rotors are damaged.

items.job: Replace rear caliper, pads and rotors (one axle)
items.note: Owners report about $550-$1,700 depending on how many parts were replaced.

items.t: Some replacement accelerator pedals can bind (recall)
items.job: Replace accelerator pedal (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 19E-068. Only cars that had a replacement pedal installed are affected.

items.t: Trunk wiring can short and kill rear lights (recall)
items.job: Repair trunk wiring harness (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 04V-429.

items.job: Replace alternator
items.note: Owners report about $250-$1,200. A remanufactured alternator is the low end.

items.job: Replace starter motor
items.note: Owners report about $400-$900.

items.job: Replace ignition coil (one)
items.note: Replacing all four coils with plugs costs roughly $500-$750.

items.job: Replace upstream air-fuel ratio sensor
items.note: Owners report about $300-$650.

items.t: Water pump leak or bearing noise
items.job: Replace water pump and drive belt
items.note: Owners report about $350-$600.

items.job: Replace engine/transmission mounts (two)
items.note: Owners report about $750 for two mounts.

items.job: Replace front lower control arm compliance bushings
items.note: An alignment adds about $100-$150.

items.t: Clunk from worn sway bar links
items.job: Replace sway bar end links (pair)
items.note: Owners report about $110-$200.

items.job: Replace door lock actuator
items.note: Owners report about $175-$385 per door.

items.t: Dashboard or navigation lights go dark
items.job: Repair or replace navigation control board or gauge cluster lighting
items.note: A specialist board repair is often about $100-$350.

items.job: Adjust or replace driver seat track
items.note: Owners report about $600 at a dealer.

items.job: Lubricate pedal pivots or replace clutch master cylinder
items.note: A master cylinder replacement was about $390 for one owner.

items.t: Stability control (VSA) or ABS unit failure
items.job: Replace VSA/ABS modulator
items.note: Owners report about $1,200-$2,500. A rebuilt unit costs less.

items.t: Exhaust leak at the manifold or flex pipe
items.job: Replace exhaust flex pipe or manifold gasket
items.note: Owners report about $180-$400; a cracked manifold costs more.

items.t: Bluetooth phone connection drops or will not pair
items.job: Update software or replace hands-free (HFL) module
items.note: Re-pairing the phone is free. A new module is the high end.
